clean_body: | | | Fellow activist, Today marks the deadline for the Pennsylvania budget process. As a reminder, our state budget is a moral document – where state legislators have a unique opportunity to pass legislation to counteract the Trump regime’s “Big Beautiful Bill” and instead move critical issues forward, such as raising our minimum wage, fairly funding K-12 and higher education, legalizing adult-use marijuana, and defending abortion access. But here’s the thing: PA’s funding priorities are going to be set well before Trump’s bill gets signed into law, which means we may have major gaps in our budget. As Governor Shapiro stated in the Pennsylvania Capital-Star , “Any lawmaker in D.C. who thinks the commonwealth can backfill this massive hole they’ve created is wrong – and these cuts will have real life consequences for Pennsylvanians.” Who we elect, from Washington to our state legislature, the courts, and beyond, has major implications for our state. That is why it’s so critical that we engage our centered communities on the ground and make sure voters understand the role that elected officials play in their everyday lives. However, as the second quarter comes to a close, we are noticing that funding is not moving as quickly as we had anticipated. That means grassroots individual donations are more important than ever. In order to maintain our current level of operations and to ramp up as we prepare for the crucial Supreme Court retention elections and other judicial, local and municipal elections happening in Pennsylvania this year, we need your help. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: In this together, Team NPP Donations to the New Pennsylvania Project supports our staff’s community engagement efforts including; organizing and hosting town halls, educational webinars, community conversations, and creating digital content, bi-weekly blasts and social media to reach the communities we engage year-round. | | The New Pennsylvania Project (NPP) is a voting rights organization with a year-round primary focus on voter registration, civic education, and mobilization. NPP centers historically disenfranchised and often neglected Black, Indigenous and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth in our work. name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to children’sentertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zashsisaaqkr7m3a7hjprjj0msbmlvf9s1u284l8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4cpi64pr6chh2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5ah9gu7seev41b2l90kavfadnevp7c2ihbuajg0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4cpi64pr6chh2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6387ft9uod4mofbq5qlhidfjud87hvavvs2ui9g_rp22sh2s8i6epb4cpi64pr6chh2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. We cannot let our foot off the gas.
#

Team, it’s Gabby Giffords. Speaking is still difficult for me, but I have something important to say.

We cannot take our foot off the gas in the fight for gun safety.
Republicans are trying to pass their “big, beautiful bill” through Congress -- including making it easier to obtain dangerous gun silencers.
If Donald Trump signs this into law, it’ll only help criminals and the corporations selling these weapons. This is _unacceptable_ , and we cannot back down.
[**GIFFORDS is working to stop this provision and stand up to the Trump administration’s attacks on gun safety -- but we need more grassroots support. Will you please contribute $3 before our FEC deadline expires at midnight?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june25.m4W6Vr&refcode=em250630-1-b&t=2&akid=10640%2E3935704%2ETrXs8O)

Peter,

At the Center, our legal action can mean the difference between a clinic staying open or being forced to close its doors—the difference between access to essential care and having nowhere to turn. Every case we take on fights back against dangerous anti-abortion laws and defends the right to reproductive freedom.

My colleagues and I have fought in courtrooms across the United States, defending our most fundamental rights, but we _never_ fight alone. [**You are the reason we can take on these challenging, groundbreaking lawsuits.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110544063/554705710/1126318745?sourceid=1150769&utm_campaign=25emige-0610aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzgwZWVmZS1jYTU1LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FwWXlp2GsuKdv4Ic6F2j_Pz3WQ5y5_23usZX80v8Sj0=&emci=5214e09c-8550-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=8c80eefe-ca55-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237)

I want to take you behind the curtain, and show you just how your support drives real impact:

**In Arizona...** your donations funded lawsuit after lawsuit where we worked with Dr. Paul Isaacson and other brave providers to strike down harmful abortion laws and fight to enforce a voter-approved constitutional amendment to protect abortion access.

**In Michigan...** you helped secure a huge win when a court struck down burdensome restrictions that remained after voters passed the Reproductive Freedom For All Act.

**In Tennessee...** your support funded legal and compliance support for CHOICES clinic, preparing them for the post-_Roe_ trigger ban and helping them expand their services into neighboring Illinois to reach more patients.

body:
No better way to enjoy the summer than being outside and supporting local Republicans!

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/8a971e7bfe54/a-week-full-of-golf-and-parades?e=72dace1453)

|
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
|
# Enjoying the Outdoors!
---
|
---
| Even though my swing is not as good as it used to be, one thing I still love to do is stop by and support our county GOPs at their golf outings. These last 2 weeks I had the opportunity to support the Clinton and Jasper county GOP golf outings. Chairs Jordan Brewer and Jason Armold are amazing leaders in their county who know how to put on a good event.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | On top of another good weekend, I also had the chance to stop by in my home county for the Morgan County GOP Breakfast. The speaker was as fantastic as the food and it was an opportunity for our new intern Sydney to learn the ropes and help out with our campaign.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| Finally to cap an eventful June, the team and I made it up to Clinton County again for their annual parade in Kirklin. I love these small towns where everyone can come together and have a great time. We even got 3rd place behind the veterans and the student float so I will take that as a job well done.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Please check out our website and social media and make sure to tell your friends and family about our campaign. Believe it or not the election is only 10 months away already!

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39854%2E3422442%2EMxdN05)
Dear Derek,
If you told me a few years ago that I’d be emailing people about a mid-year fundraising deadline, I would’ve looked at you like you were nuts.
I was a single mom and consumer advocate, and I never dreamed of running for office, let alone reaching out to grassroots supporters across the country.
That’s the power of emails like this one. They allowed me to flip a House seat from red to blue as a first time candidate, and they’re powering my campaign for California Governor now.
**Today is one of the most important days in our campaign so far.** At midnight, we have our first fundraising reporting deadline of this election cycle, which means we’ll have to tell everyone exactly how much money we’ve raised. People will be looking to this report to judge the strength or weakness of this campaign.
And because I reject money from corporations, lobbyists, and executives at Big Pharma, Big Oil, and Big Banks, I rely on emails like this to raise the resources I need to win and fight for families in office.
**[There’s no way I can do this without you, Derek. clean_body: Your inbox may feel full, but I promise these emails have purpose. Dear Derek, If you told me a few years ago that I’d be emailing people about a mid-year fundraising deadline, I would’ve looked at you like you were nuts. I was a single mom and consumer advocate, and I never dreamed of running for office, let alone reaching out to grassroots supporters across the country. That’s the power of emails like this one. They allowed me to flip a House seat from red to blue as a first time candidate, and they’re powering my campaign for California Governor now. Today is one of the most important days in our campaign so far. At midnight, we have our first fundraising reporting deadline of this election cycle, which means we’ll have to tell everyone exactly how much money we’ve raised. People will be looking to this report to judge the strength or weakness of this campaign. And because I reject money from corporations, lobbyists, and executives at Big Pharma, Big Oil, and Big Banks, I rely on emails like this to raise the resources I need to win and fight for families in office. Thanks for being a supporter, Katie Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change.

| | Steve Mietz, Save the Redwood League’s [new president and CEO,](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110551204/554728804/-583221787?utm_campaign=qa&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-mar&ms=mietz&Content=60-day&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjZhN2FkNWE1LWQzNTUtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=22pyU3Vbqd7tHCg3pyyxgTwE4IE3NSUvBgRDe7sah48=&emci=b013a65d-ba52-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=6a7ad5a5-d355-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=1504551) has had a couple months to get his boots underneath him (and a bit muddy). Now that he’s settled, we sat down to talk about what brought him to the League and why this is such an exciting time to work in conservation.
---
---
| | **Q: Do you remember what first got you excited about wilderness and conservation?** **A:** My dad and my brothers were all Eagle Scouts, so naturally I became an Eagle Scout too and did lots of camping around New Jersey where I grew up. But my big awakening was a high school backpacking trip in northern New Mexico. I hadn’t really been out of the New Jersey area before that. The wilderness and dramatic mountains of New Mexico opened my mind to the possibility that the West might be a better fit for my soul.
---
| | **You had a long career as a superintendent in the National Park Service before joining the League. What drew you to public lands service?** Well, besides getting to work amidst the best natural treasures in the United States, I love history, natural resources, visitor experiences, and stewardship. So the National Park Service was a natural fit for me. It wrapped all these things together into preserving and protecting incredible places for future generations. It's such a compelling mission.
---
---
Mietz speaks as superintendent of Redwood National and State Parks. Photo by Max Forster.
---
**Quick—what’s the most underrated national park?** Great Basin National Park, in eastern Nevada. You can see bristlecone pines there—some of the oldest trees in the world. You can explore caves and even climb a 13,000-foot mountain, all in one day. It's one of the least-visited national parks, but all the facilities are brand new. Want to experience a slower-paced and less-crowded national park like the parks were in the 1950s? Go to Great Basin.
---
**What excites you the most about leading the League? **
Being freed up to spend my time focused on the core mission of protecting and restoring the redwoods. As a park superintendent, I had a million different things to manage. But now my chief responsibility is the revival of these incredible forests throughout California. I took the juiciest, most fun parts of my park service career—resource protection and connecting with people—and now I get to do them all the time.
---
**You seem eager to meet this moment, when conservation is facing political and economic challenges. What motivates you? ** I grew up in the shadow of the 1960s. By the time I was coming of age two decades later, it felt like most of the big environmental battles had been won. Crucial laws protecting the environment had been passed, like the Clean Water Act and the Clean Air Act. But now it feels like that progress is unraveling. If we don't stand up and fight for the environment in a smart way, that progress could be lost.
---
**How do we do that?**
By being positive and proactive to protect the planet and places we love from existential threats. The League is well positioned to do exactly that. We're mission focused on these magnificent and essential trees, which is such an awesome place to be. It gives us a strong footing and keeps us grounded. Focusing on restoration and all the wonderful things that can be done with our fantastic partners—it helps us stay positive. We really can accomplish so much.
---
---
Mietz and son dancing at the 2025 Take Me to the Trees event. Photo by Drew Alitzer Photography.
---
**You’ve already become known around the office for your abundant positivity. ** Yep, that’s me: Audaciously optimistic. That’s what keeps me going, and it’s the message I have for the conservation community. Let’s not get lost in what seems too hard. Let’s not get caught up in doom scrolling. Together we can make a real difference, no matter what headwinds slow us down.
---
**Speaking of slowing down, when you’re not working, what are you dreaming of?** That’s an easy one: backpacking. I’d have a hard time choosing between a few months on the Pacific Crest Trail or the Continental Divide Trail. Just savoring that deep time in the mountains. I don't have as much time as I get busier—and older—and I really miss that intimate connection with wild places. A few years ago, I took my oldest son on a two-week backpacking trip in the same New Mexico mountains that started everything for me. It was incredible. I’d love to do it again.
---
**Being an Eagle Scout and spending decades in the National Park Service, you must have some incredible stories from the backcountry. ** Well, sure. I’ve floated down the Colorado River through the Grand Canyon 35 times! Oh, and I trapped a live grizzly bear once.
---
**Wait, you trapped a live grizzly bear?** Yeah, well, I didn’t trap it, but I kinda helped. I was working with the US Fish and Wildlife Service's Grizzly Bear Recovery Program which tracked grizzlies across Montana and adjacent states. To get data, they trapped and briefly sedated the bears—no grizzlies were harmed. I figured I’d show up for a weekend, bring the beer, and not see any bears—they hadn’t trapped one all summer. But we got one the first day I was there. I remember hearing it roar like a lion. After the bear was sedated, I was abandoned by my work partner, who left to check the rest of the traps. I had a few hours all alone with a sleeping grizzly. It was pretty darn cool. Until the bear started to wake up.
---
**Well, you’re probably not going to be dealing with grizzly bears at the League. ** That’s okay! I’ll always have my grizzly story.

clean_body: Steve Mietz on leading with optimism (and working with grizzly bears)| | | | | | | Steve Mietz, Save the Redwood League’s has had a couple months to get his boots underneath him (and a bit muddy). Now that he’s settled, we sat down to talk about what brought him to the League and why this is such an exciting time to work in conservation. | | Q: Do you remember what first got you excited about wilderness and conservation? A: My dad and my brothers were all Eagle Scouts, so naturally I became an Eagle Scout too and did lots of camping around New Jersey where I grew up. But my big awakening was a high school backpacking trip in northern New Mexico. I hadn’t really been out of the New Jersey area before that. The wilderness and dramatic mountains of New Mexico opened my mind to the possibility that the West might be a better fit for my soul. | | You had a long career as a superintendent in the National Park Service before joining the League. What drew you to public lands service? Well, besides getting to work amidst the best natural treasures in the United States, I love history, natural resources, visitor experiences, and stewardship. So the National Park Service was a natural fit for me. It wrapped all these things together into preserving and protecting incredible places for future generations. It's such a compelling mission. Mietz speaks as superintendent of Redwood National and State Parks. Photo by Max Forster. Quick—what’s the most underrated national park? Great Basin National Park, in eastern Nevada. You can see bristlecone pines there—some of the oldest trees in the world. You can explore caves and even climb a 13,000-foot mountain, all in one day. It's one of the least-visited national parks, but all the facilities are brand new. Want to experience a slower-paced and less-crowded national park like the parks were in the 1950s? Go to Great Basin. What excites you the most about leading the League? Being freed up to spend my time focused on the core mission of protecting and restoring the redwoods. As a park superintendent, I had a million different things to manage. But now my chief responsibility is the revival of these incredible forests throughout California. I took the juiciest, most fun parts of my park service career—resource protection and connecting with people—and now I get to do them all the time. You seem eager to meet this moment, when conservation is facing political and economic challenges. What motivates you? I grew up in the shadow of the 1960s. By the time I was coming of age two decades later, it felt like most of the big environmental battles had been won. Crucial laws protecting the environment had been passed, like the Clean Water Act and the Clean Air Act. But now it feels like that progress is unraveling. If we don't stand up and fight for the environment in a smart way, that progress could be lost. How do we do that? By being positive and proactive to protect the planet and places we love from existential threats. The League is well positioned to do exactly that. We're mission focused on these magnificent and essential trees, which is such an awesome place to be. It gives us a strong footing and keeps us grounded. Focusing on restoration and all the wonderful things that can be done with our fantastic partners—it helps us stay positive. We really can accomplish so much. Mietz and son dancing at the 2025 Take Me to the Trees event. Photo by Drew Alitzer Photography. You’ve already become known around the office for your abundant positivity. Yep, that’s me: Audaciously optimistic. That’s what keeps me going, and it’s the message I have for the conservation community. Let’s not get lost in what seems too hard. Let’s not get caught up in doom scrolling. Together we can make a real difference, no matter what headwinds slow us down. Speaking of slowing down, when you’re not working, what are you dreaming of? That’s an easy one: backpacking. I’d have a hard time choosing between a few months on the Pacific Crest Trail or the Continental Divide Trail. Just savoring that deep time in the mountains. I don't have as much time as I get busier—and older—and I really miss that intimate connection with wild places. A few years ago, I took my oldest son on a two-week backpacking trip in the same New Mexico mountains that started everything for me. It was incredible. I’d love to do it again. Being an Eagle Scout and spending decades in the National Park Service, you must have some incredible stories from the backcountry. Well, sure. I’ve floated down the Colorado River through the Grand Canyon 35 times! Oh, and I trapped a live grizzly bear once. Wait, you trapped a live grizzly bear? Yeah, well, I didn’t trap it, but I kinda helped. I was working with the US Fish and Wildlife Service's Grizzly Bear Recovery Program which tracked grizzlies across Montana and adjacent states. To get data, they trapped and briefly sedated the bears—no grizzlies were harmed. I figured I’d show up for a weekend, bring the beer, and not see any bears—they hadn’t trapped one all summer. But we got one the first day I was there. I remember hearing it roar like a lion. After the bear was sedated, I was abandoned by my work partner, who left to check the rest of the traps. I had a few hours all alone with a sleeping grizzly. It was pretty darn cool. Until the bear started to wake up. Well, you’re probably not going to be dealing with grizzly bears at the League. That’s okay! I’ll always have my grizzly story. | | | | | Top: Photo by Max Whittaker | | | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- |

By Illinois Review

In one of the first nationwide hypothetical polls for the 2028 Democratic presidential primary, Illinois Governor and billionaire JB Pritzker ranks at the bottom, receiving the lowest level of support from minority voters as prominent Democrats begin preparing for potential campaigns.

On Friday, the well-regarded Emerson College Polling released new results showing former U.S. Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg leading the Democratic field with 16 percent support. Former Vice President Kamala Harris follows at 13 percent, with California Governor Gavin Newsom close behind at 12 percent.

clean_body: It's time to take care of business | = Peter, It's Gretchen Whitmer. When I reached out to you last year, the 2024 election had just shown us how deeply divided Americans are about our vision for our country. Today, we're seeing health care and basic necessities being ripped away from the people who need it most. Democrats have a clear to-do list. We need to get organized, we need to get energized, and we need to show up for the people who rely on us to make a real difference in their lives. It's time to take care of business, Peter, which, in Democratic politics, means one thing — it's time to look to EMILYs List. My friends at EMILYs List have been helping Democratic pro-choice women win elections for 40 years and counting. Their role in changing the face of power in American politics can't be overstated, and I'm proud to be an EMILYs List woman myself.= | = In times of upheaval, we need to look to what has always been true. And here's what I know for sure: More freedom is better than less. Some rights, like the right to make our own medical decisions, are nonnegotiable. And when more women are at the decision-making table, we all win. I was thrilled to see that the very first 2025 endorsements EMILYs List made were for women running for governor. I'm here to tell you firsthand, Peter: We need more women in charge of our states. Republicans haven't taken a day off from dismantling our democracy. So neither can we, in our work to get every last one of them out. | Peter — Normally when you see my name in your inbox, I like the messages to be different from the other emails you get from most elected officials. I've written to you in detail about the depth of corruption and self-enrichment of the Trump Administration, the President's thirst for political retribution and intimidation, along with other things I am seeing or working on in Washington, D.C. and at home in Georgia. This message is different. It's more direct. I am reaching out today with a last-ditch request for a contribution to my campaign before our end-of-quarter fundraising drive comes to a close. Here's why: This race will be one of the most competitive and expensive in the nation. I am the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024 and that makes me MAGA’s #1 target. | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znhqsapsqsrlvqd6dha1ua7r5el3nf5f1lt9fin8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4cpi6eoj6c9h2bs)

Dear Friend,
---
This is the most personal letter I’ve ever written.
---
I’m writing to you not as America’s Mayor, not as a former prosecutor, not even as President Trump’s former attorney, but as an 80-year-old man – a grandfather and a patriot – staring down a 20-year prison sentence for doing what I believed was right.
---
I’ve taken on mobsters. I’ve faced terrorists. I’ve battled corruption. I’ve been through it all.
---
_Or so I thought..._
---
**...But now, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
They think they’ve finally got me! Left me with no escape, no lifeline – especially after they’ve already STRIPPED me of my law licenses!
---
_No pardon.
No protection.
No cavalry coming over the hill. _
---
But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.
---
So, with my back against the wall, I’m turning to the one thing that can save me: **_the collective voices of MILLIONS of patriots like _YOU_._**
---
My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — [**“THE PEOPLE’S PARDON”**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpsp20re2bk4csk96mql4j3pkvtjfpc1adsghjf8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4cpi6eoj6c9h2bs) — calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES.

| | | Friend - We can't afford to lose your support!

**I 've come to truly appreciate your support. I know everything you've given to get us to where we are today. **

But you know just as well as I do how quickly things can change.

I wanted to inform you sooner rather than later that, as of today, your **House GOP Membership**** ** has YET to be renewed.

While I value having a member like you on our team, I also know that losing critical members at a time like this could bring everything we've accomplished so far to a standstill.

_I 'm not at all worried about your continued commitment. The last thing I would ever do is question your loyalty. But I'd hate for you to miss out on your chance to renew today. _

Friend, We are more than halfway through 2025 and saying that it has been a difficult year to be a Democrat is an understatement. The last six months have made the first Trump administration look like child's play. We've seen greencard holders deported to El Salvadorian torture prisons, the arrest of elected officials by ICE, the launch of a surveillance database to keep tabs on its opposition, and so so much more. Coming off the heels of our devastating defeat in 2024 and new escalations from MAGA everyday, it's been easy to grow apathetic and assume this is it and that we'll never get our country back. **However within the past month the tide has begun to turn:**

On top of this, last week, we saw the **earth shattering victory against all odds by Zohran Mamdani** in the NYC mayoral election against right-wing Democrat Andrew Cuomo who was funded by the same billionaires who elected Trump. Zohran won because his candidacy offered fire and brimstone resistance to MAGA. Whereas with Cuomo voters saw that while he might rhetorically resist Trump, in substance he would do nothing to prevent Trump from steam rolling over NYC. This new generation of aggressively anti-Trump Democrat is birthing the rise of a tea-party movement within the Democratic party. The tea party famously hamstrung Obama's two terms making it nearly impossible for him to get anything done in the House. They effectively roadblocked Obama's agenda by offering steep consequences to any Republican colleague who broke with their agenda of complete opposition. [1]Justice Democrats

Justice Democrats is facing our second, critical end-of-quarter
fundraising deadline tonight at midnight, and we’re behind on reaching
our goal.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250630?refcode=em20250630-36805&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36805_1203867_M-gfri&akid=36805%2E1203867%2EM-gfri ]Will you rush $5 or whatever you can to help us catch
up in time?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250630?refcode=em20250630-36805&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36805_1203867_M-gfri&akid=36805%2E1203867%2EM-gfri ]DONATE

Peter,

It is not an exaggeration when we say that Donald Trump and MAGA
Republicans are trying to establish fascist authoritarianism in the United
States right now.

The Trump administration is:

* Trying to repeal our fundamental rights granted in the Constitution,
such as birthright citizenship;
* Terrorizing communities and families with mass deportations carried
out by masked, unidentified ICE agents;
* Pushing a federal budget that will slash nearly $1 TRILLION from
Medicaid, Medicare, SNAP, and other safety net programs that working
and poor people rely on to survive, while giving more tax breaks to
millionaires, billionaires, and corporations.

And time after time, Trump is executing power-grabs the likes of which
we’ve never seen, claiming more executive authority while weakening the
other branches of government.

So, who will stop him? Well, with a 6-3 conservative majority (including
three justices hand-picked by Trump), we can’t count on the Supreme Court.
Just this month, they issued rulings to:

* Let states cut off Medicaid funding to Planned Parenthood, ripping
away patients’ ability to choose the doctor or provider they want —
even for critical non-abortion services that millions rely on Planned
Parenthood for;
* Allow states to ban life-saving, gender-affirming care for transgender
youth, while letting Trump keep deporting immigrants to megaprisons in
third-party countries;
* Limit the power of federal judges to issue nationwide injunctions
temporarily stopping the Trump administration’s unconstitutional
policies, such as its attempt to repeal birthright citizenship.

What about Congress? Well, Democratic leadership is asleep at the wheel.
Senate Democrats are barely putting up a fight to stop Trump’s far-right
nominees, often voting for them without pause, while the House Minority
Leader said last week that he hadn’t even looked at the bipartisan War
Powers Resolutions introduced to stop Trump from throwing us into an
unconstitutional war on Iran.

They're not going to save us,
Peter. We have to save ourselves, and that
starts with recruiting and building support for progressive, working-class
candidates from our own communities who are willing to challenge the
Do-Nothing Democrats in power.

Unlike the establishment that relies on massive checks from corporate
lobby groups and dark money super PACs, Justice Democrats depends entirely
on donations from grassroots supporters like YOU. We can’t win big in the
2026 midterm elections without an influx of small-dollar contributions
NOW.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250630?refcode=em20250630-36805&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36805_1203867_M-gfri&akid=36805%2E1203867%2EM-gfri ]With that in mind and our end-of-quarter FEC deadline rapidly
approaching in just a few hours, please pitch in any amount to ensure we
reach our goal before it’s too late.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250630?refcode=em20250630-36805&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36805_1203867_M-gfri&akid=36805%2E1203867%2EM-gfri ]Contribute $5

I can’t thank you enough for your support.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

T**he Battle of the Alamo was a turning point in the Texas War of Independence.**
Thanks for reading The Goldstein Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..24bZNWRjLH2twc3TcAPdZPTjzYO5w6KrKcpHSIaBMOk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=167199243)
The Alamo, adjacent to the San Antonio River was first a mission that later a fort. In December 1835, George Collinsworth and Benjamin Milam led a group of Texan volunteers to overwhelm the Mexican forces and took control of the Alamo.
In February 1836, Colonel James Bowie and Lieutenant Colonel William B. Travis took command of the Texan forces at the Alamo. Additional volunteers joined including Davy Crockett, a well known legend and former congressman from Tennessee.
Despite orders from Sam Houston to abandon the fort the Texans decided to stay and fight to hold the fort.
Mexican General Santa Anna with an army in the thousands overwhelmed the much smaller army of Texan fighters who fought valiantly but were all killed.
The loss of the Alamo hardened the Texas resistance against Mexico. Later that year General Sam Houston defeated Santa Anna and took him prisoner. This victory led to Texas independence. Texas later joined the United States.
**Remember the Alamo was the call to battle and the call to defeat Mexico and create the independent state of Texas.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/338c5f85-5a35-4779-9eb9-415e4769887b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

body:
We must go where the facts take us.
#
**Last year** , it was revealed that the Supreme Court received nearly $5 million in luxury gifts from MAGA megadonors — $4.2 million of which went solely to Clarence Thomas.1
**Just before the election** , SCOTUS then granted Donald Trump "absolute immunity" from prosecution for crimes he committed as President.
**And this past Friday** , SCOTUS ruled to limit the powers of our lower courts, preventing them from blocking Trump's executive orders nationwide.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250630-1.zV1f0c&refcode=em20250630-9208-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9208%2E2526796%2EkWGagq)
**The Supreme Court is in a legitimacy crisis.**
The conservative Justices are setting the stage for a Trump presidency above the law. If Congress fails to hold them accountable, it sends a dangerous signal to the special interests trying to buy them off that their actions are fair game.
[This level of corruption is shocking by any standard of a functioning democracy. Will you make a $5 contribution today so that Alexandria can keep fighting to ensure no one — no matter how rich or powerful — is above the law?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250630-1.zV1f0c&refcode=em20250630-9208-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9208%2E2526796%2EkWGagq)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250630-1.zV1f0c&refcode=em20250630-9208-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=9208%2E2526796%2EkWGagq)**
In her dissent, Justice Sonia Sotomayor, also from The Bronx, called it an "open invitation for the government to bypass the Constitution."
This is a tipping point, and inaction is a decision to erode and further delegitimize the Supreme Court. As Alexandria said, “We must go where the facts take us.”
Thank you for reading. **We'll keep you posted as more on this story develops**.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

clean_body: We must go where the facts take us. Last year , it was revealed that the Supreme Court received nearly $5 million in luxury gifts from MAGA megadonors — $4.2 million of which went solely to Clarence Thomas.1 Just before the election , SCOTUS then granted Donald Trump "absolute immunity" from prosecution for crimes he committed as President. And this past Friday , SCOTUS ruled to limit the powers of our lower courts, preventing them from blocking Trump's executive orders nationwide. The Supreme Court is in a legitimacy crisis. The conservative Justices are setting the stage for a Trump presidency above the law. If Congress fails to hold them accountable, it sends a dangerous signal to the special interests trying to buy them off that their actions are fair game. In her dissent, Justice Sonia Sotomayor, also from The Bronx, called it an "open invitation for the government to bypass the Constitution." This is a tipping point, and inaction is a decision to erode and further delegitimize the Supreme Court. As Alexandria said, “We must go where the facts take us.” Thank you for reading. We'll keep you posted as more on this story develops. In solidarity, Team AOC 1 - | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

body:
We’re not just resisting, we’re building a movement.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250630-5198-footer&t=1&akid=5198%2E420207%2EprXHUL)
Peter,
We recently wrapped up the latest Resistance Lab training, and _wow_. Folks from 34 states across the country joined us, bringing our total to over _10,000 people in all 50 states_ who’ve taken part in at least one training since we started just three months ago.
Resistance Lab is building — in real time — a growing movement of people who are trained in the most effective ways to fight authoritarians and dictators, **and turning that right into action in their neighborhoods and communities.**
Here’s what makes the Resistance Lab special:
✅ It’s rooted in real research on democratic backsliding.
✅ It’s built on the most effective nonviolent resistance strategies from pro-democracy movements across the world.
✅ And it draws on Pramila’s own 20+ years of experience organizing for economic and social justice.
**We’re not just resisting, we’re building a movement.** We’re training people to be strike-ready and street-ready so that we can transform our fear and frustration into _action_.
Every piece of Resistance Labs is funded through Pramila’s campaign — which means YOU! Pramila has never taken corporate PAC contributions and she has ALWAYS used her campaign to fund year-round organizing, not transactional mobilizing that only happens before an election.
So Peter, we’re asking if you will contribute a little more to help Resistance Lab keep up with the rapidly growing demand for the training. It’s growing fast and we need your help to keep up.
The demand for Resistance Lab keeps growing — we’ve got more than 30,000 that have signed up and with your help, we’ll keep training more and more and more. If you haven’t signed up yet, please make sure you do for the next one in a couple of weeks [HERE](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/50195?t=2&akid=5198%2E420207%2EprXHUL).

| | | | Dear Peter, We’re down to the wire — and everything is on the line. **At midnight tonight** , our fundraising books close for the quarter. clean_body: | | | | | Friend, A proud Grand Junction native, Congressman Jeff Hurd has hit the ground running from day ONE—fighting the good fight to deliver real results for the good people of Colorado. But here’s the thing: even though it feels like his term just started, the next election is already around the corner. Friend,
We’re just hours away from closing the books on our first fundraising quarter, and this moment matters. Not just because it’s our first big public statement, but because it’s our chance to prove that a grassroots, people-powered campaign can take on deep-pocketed special interests and **win**.
We’re up against one of the most vulnerable Republicans in Congress, David Valadao – someone who votes to gut healthcare, restrict reproductive rights, and enable an extreme MAGA agenda that leaves working families behind.
**That’s not representation. That’s abandonment.**
I’m running because _the Central Valley deserves better._ We deserve a representative who understands the struggles of working families – because they’ve lived them. Someone who will fight every single day for affordable healthcare, good-paying jobs, reproductive freedom, and opportunity for all – not just the well-connected few.
But if we’re going to flip this seat, we have to show we’re building something real. That’s why I’m hoping you’ll chip in $3 before midnight.

Aiming to stop illegal registration and voting by individuals who have never lived in Arizona or anywhere in the U.S.

| | | | |
### RITE PAC SUES TO BLOCK ILLEGAL VOTING BY NON-RESIDENTS IN ARIZONA
(Phoenix, AZ – June 30, 2025) – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections PAC (“RITE PAC”) [has sued Arizona Secretary of State Adrian Fontes](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=59d08cd073&e=ea91f782ea) in state court to stop the illegal registration of, and voting by, individuals who have **never lived in Arizona or anywhere in the United States.** The case challenges a state law that allows U.S. citizens born abroad to vote in all Arizona elections based solely on their parent’s registration in the state. This law directly conflicts with Arizona’s Constitution that specifically requires individuals to be residents of the state in order to vote there.“Residency is not something that can be inherited like a family heirloom,” said RITE PAC President and CEO Justin Riemer. “Arizona’s Constitution is crystal clear: voting is reserved for those who live in Arizona. Allowing people who have never set foot in the state to cast ballots is an affront to the concept of self-governance and undermines the integrity of the state’s elections.”The complaint asks the court to block election officials from registering or accepting ballots from individuals who have never been Arizona residents.RITE PAC is an organization that supports litigation to protect the rule of law in our elections. It is committed to restoring the principle that only those who live here, and who are invested in our communities and our future, should decide our elections. RITE PAC is sponsoring this litigation on behalf of the Republican Party of Arizona and its Chairman. ###

Good afternoon —
I’m writing a quick note while I take a coffee break.
As we prepare to close the books on our fundraising for the quarter, I just want to say thank you. This grassroots team gives me so much hope.
Hope that we can still build politics of grace not grievance, a politics that puts people over the profits of the powerful.
Hope that we can cut through the noise and get real things done for working families.
Hope that, even in difficult moments, we can still choose compassion, fairness, and progress.
Because right now, we’re seeing the opposite. The GOP’s big, ugly bill is a reminder of everything we’re up against — a proposal that robs regular people of health care to reward billionaires.
While they double down on their cruelty, I’m holding onto something stronger: this grassroots movement.
So as we head into the final hours of this end-of-quarter deadline, I just want to say thank you — for powering this campaign, for believing in a better way, and for giving me the fuel I need to keep up the fight.

Sorry to email you on a Monday morning, but I wouldn’t be sending this if it wasn’t important.

Sorry to email you on a Monday, but I wouldn’t be sending this if it wasn’t important. I just got off the phone with my finance director, and she let me know that we’re still $1,423 short of our end-of-quarter fundraising goal. With Republicans already targeting my seat, hitting this goal before our numbers go public is crucial if we’re going to prove that this people-powered team has what it takes to defend OR-05. body:
Together, we’re resisting Trump’s authoritarian regime and holding the powerful to account. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWrB--UTmOr_Q6IR-pEq8on6hnkKKGUlq5xgrMfhl9qd-okQ3BbmIE8tU-6YCEVKeIoz23qtfDAw0dFtBzSpGLkxVEwhmFCpcOSAWR9IixYPqwbTk672rsAfX3hszOL19zfDt9hQpOVd5HAqTW0Bm9oQ/4hs/MrCruPDlTWWmTPAsN_0VRA/h0/h001.f7R6jTBeYtOWFn34Rnv86z5-tW80HOfL9nmW_onOzq8)
---
Friend, Why are you resisting Trump? Is it because of his attempts to destroy public education, get rid of programs that uplift equity and inclusion, and remove historically-accurate curriculum in our schools? Is it his attacks on our immigrant neighbors, stripping away of our civil rights protections, targeting people who speak up for Palestinians, the Muslim ban, and targeting of our LGBTQ+ community? Is it attacks on our federal government, including federal workers who serve our veterans, Social Security recipients, people with Medicaid, and more? Is it his and Republicans’ policies that are paying for tax cuts for billionaires on the backs of working people and vulnerable communities? Is it his disregard for our Constitution, our courts, and the rule of law? Is it his attacks on collective bargaining rights? **The bottom line is that we are resisting Trump and fascism together.** Students and seniors, veterans and activists, communities of color, working people and retirees. Our voices and our activism are more powerful together, and I will never stop fighting by your side. **Today marks a critical fundraising deadline.** After today, we will report to the Federal Election Commission on how much money we’ve raised and spent, and how much cash-on-hand we have for the fight ahead. **We know that billionaire-funded anti-democratic forces want to defeat us.** They have unlimited resources to spread fear and lies rooted in racism and dehumanization. They want to silence our dissent and take away our rights while protecting their fortunes. subject: Will you chip in $25?
body:
Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Unsubscribe

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syonqb&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxokljbgoianptn9s9lybluxerq5i8k314sisk3uhyfbmulpguo2a8vzoj3ac9nzc9qwtdvweg3ewotlzbumf60yiotvfrcwyoq0pal7ola09z5usb9niekljhp57uuo61nxhzmnbt9uxb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syonqb&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syonqb&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syonqb&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syonqb&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxokljbgoianptn9s9lybluxerq5i8k314sisk3uhyfbmulpguo2a8vzoj3ac9nzc9qwtdvweg3ewotlzbumf60yiotvfrcwyoq0pal7ola09z5usb9niekljhp57uuo61nxhzmnbt9uxb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syonqb&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syonqb&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Hi, folks. It’s Oregon Secretary of State, Tobias Read.
I’ll keep it simple: We can't afford anyone on the sidelines at this critical moment.
From safeguarding ballot access to defending against disinformation, the work ahead is urgent, and campaigns like ours are leading the charge.
But we’re up against well-funded bad actors who don’t care about the truth or our democracy, so I need your help to ensure we have the resources needed to fight back.
That starts with meeting my team’s mission-critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline at midnight tonight. Can I count on you to chip in $10 or more right now? Together, let’s take a stand for our democracy before it’s too late. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250630em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250630em]
Every dollar you give before the deadline sends a powerful message: voters are ready to fight back for our democracy.
And while President Donald Trump and his MAGA allies try to get away with a slate of attacks on the rule of law, sending messages like that has never been more important.
Let’s show these anti-democratic extremists the power of this grassroots team. Chip in any amount before the deadline and let’s get to work. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250630em]

Birthright citizenship is a right guaranteed to all Americans in the 14th amendment, which was ratified 157 years ago. It guarantees citizenship to anyone born within the United States, regardless of their parents citizenship status. **Ending birthright citizenship will make millions of Americans eligible for deportation -- causing utter chaos and panic throughout America. ** Just last week, _militarized Border Control agents in Huntington Park, California used breach charges to blow open the door of a home belonging to a U.S. citizen without warning, raiding the house brandishing assault weapons while children were present_ , and searching for a migrant who they claimed to be at the home (_he wasn 't_):

_This is Trump's America._
---
**Trump 's mass deportation campaign is making American neighborhoods resemble a warzone. **And _it will only get worse if birthright citizenship is revoked by an unconstitutional executive order by our wannabe fascist president._ With federal judges now limited in their ability to issue nationwide injunctions against Trump's extremist agenda, _state courts will play an even more critical role in protecting democracy_ -- ensuring that rights guaranteed under state constitutions are not trampled by federal overreach. clean_body: Ending birthright citizenship will make millions of Americans eligible for deportation — causing utter chaos and panic throughout America. | | Peter, Last week, the Supreme Court ruled in Trump's favor, handing him unprecedented power. The ruling limits the ability of federal judges to block Trump's unconstitutional executive orders from taking place nationwide and allows Trump's executive order to end birthright citizenship to proceed through lower courts. | Birthright citizenship is a right guaranteed to all Americans in the 14th amendment, which was ratified 157 years ago. It guarantees citizenship to anyone born within the United States, regardless of their parents citizenship status. Ending birthright citizenship will make millions of Americans eligible for deportation -- causing utter chaos and panic throughout America. Just last week, militarized Border Control agents in Huntington Park, California used breach charges to blow open the door of a home belonging to a U.S. citizen without warning, raiding the house brandishing assault weapons while children were present , and searching for a migrant who they claimed to be at the home (he wasn 't): | This is Trump's America. Trump 's mass deportation campaign is making American neighborhoods resemble a warzone. And it will only get worse if birthright citizenship is revoked by an unconstitutional executive order by our wannabe fascist president. With federal judges now limited in their ability to issue nationwide injunctions against Trump's extremist agenda, state courts will play an even more critical role in protecting democracy -- ensuring that rights guaranteed under state constitutions are not trampled by federal overreach. That is why Defend Our Courts is leading the effort to protect Democratic state Supreme Court judges from being ousted by Trump's billionaire collaborators in upcoming elections, starting in Pennsylvania in 2025. We just unveiled our first ad that will be hitting the airwaves in PA and we are planning to launch this ad blitz on 4th of July.To reach all the voters we have identified, we need to raise $250,000 before midnight TONIGHT to fully fund this campaign. name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
subject: I’ll be honest
body:
| | Peter, I’ll be honest: fundraising has been slower than we’d hoped so far this year.

I know things are tough for so many people right now – while working families are worried about the safety of our streets and being able to afford eggs without reaching for the credit card, we’re being inundated with headlines about petty political fights and extremists dismantling our government.

It can feel overwhelming, but I’m here to reassure you that together, we can defend our shared values and deliver real solutions to the problems our communities face.

| | Friend , Trump may call this budget his “**big, beautiful bill** ”, but it’s really a big, billionaire bill. There’s nothing ‘beautiful’ about slashing Medicaid, cutting food assistance, or ripping away support from tens of millions of working families—just to hand out tax breaks to billionaires and corporate donors. **This bill is cruel. It’s corrupt. And it’s costing lives.** Congress is voting on this billionaire handout THIS WEEK and we need your help. We can’t afford to stay silent. That’s why we’re asking supporters across the country to take two quick but powerful actions **right now** :
📣 **1\. Write to your members of Congress** **
**📞**2\. Pick up the phone and call them**
**📱3. Spread the word to your friends**
Let them know you see what’s happening—and you expect them to vote **NO** on this cruel and corrupt budget.
---

| | Here’s the truth:
* This budget slashes health care for seniors, veterans, and low-income families.

* It takes food off the table for millions of kids and working parents.

* It guts programs rural communities rely on.

* And it does all of this to pay for more tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy.

This isn’t about politics—it’s about people’s lives.
And we have a small window to stop it.**Trump can call it beautiful. But we know the truth.** Let’s make sure Congress hears it—loud and clear. In solidarity,
ECU Organizing Team

So, I thought I'd reach out to you one more time.

Meeting our goal will allow us to:

* **Counter false narratives** with free online courses on the Constitution, American history, Christianity, and Marxism--these courses are especially important for the growing number of young people in our audience.

* **Increase our outreach on social media** --including X (formerly known as Twitter), where we often share our educational content, such as lectures from Hillsdale events, free online courses, and learning videos.

* **Restore excellence in K-12 education** by establishing and guiding classical schools nationwide. There are dozens of Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools across the country that teach thousands of students and have long waiting lists. subject: I was taught that if you’re going to do a job, you do it right.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
Peter,

St. Louis has given me everything — it’s where I grew up, where I built my career, and where I learned what it means to fight for the community I love.

The people of this city have always had faith in me to show up when it counts, and that’s exactly what I’m doing now in Congress. More than ever before, _things are chaotic._

Too many politicians in Washington seem comfortable letting the promise of America slip through the cracks and chasing personal gain instead of public service. I was raised differently. Hey, this is Vivek Ramaswamy, and I'd like to share a personal story with you.
When I was in middle school, my father got laid off from his factory job at the General Electric plant in Evendale, Ohio. He was one of the hardest workers there, but like thousands of other good men and women, he was laid off without warning.
Most people would complain, whine, and stomp their feet, saying, "It's not fair!".
But not MY dad. He didn't cry about victimhood or racism.
Instead, he picked himself up, dusted himself off, got a new job, and enrolled in night school law classes for the next four years.
But because money was tight, he and my mother couldn't afford childcare. Every day after middle school, my dad would pick me up and we'd drive for 45 minutes to the University of Kentucky across the river.
I'd sit in the back of his law school classes every night.
Most kids my age would hate the idea of spending all day at school just to go to ANOTHER school at night. But not me.
I was FASCINATED, learning about the Constitution, the principles of law, and Supreme Court decisions.
So why do I even share this story with you in the first place?
Because that time in my life taught me a lesson I've never forgotten: Every hardship is an opportunity - if you're willing to work for it.
That mindset is the foundation of my campaign.
I don't believe in a culture of victimhood. I believe in the American Dream. I believe in merit over DEI. In hard work over handouts. In family, faith, and responsibility, not grievance and blame.
Right now, we have a real opportunity to reverse Radical Leftist policies. An opportunity to show how the nuclear family is the best form of governance. An opportunity to showcase how capitalism lifts people out of poverty. An opportunity to reinstate the American Dream.
And I know that you're one of the dedicated American Patriots who believe in that vision.
That's why I need you with me, Peter.
[If you can, please consider donating $10 to my campaign for governor today. I need all the help I can get to restore the American Dream for Ohioans and Americans alike.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=77fa5f62241f44ac88952c40e9c76e56&_e=v6yoPalxgcJF1Gbz4J9gn4rdfJJSJD_pUvg8GhoHo6GvjjeBTxsN_7GeZai48OhuFdTj1d8ZdxXlbV549BB_rn7T_W61EYBb9z2S6xvDSW_DaxyaIbpdrqls-x_OfDDw1yAwIB-S8yM40I1QDRHdoTfasPYcrXikLMOVsy7868iGsCdX31EK-XKZS5JcrwP9YNiLTOy2OGV9eDx75Dkg7WubHqROJFnaV-dY4Y2-88ow4-gUQuVtGHip7uXmfiG2Vdg3jqmS0jjDy3GP0exxW8utw-LXw0z3-NQ50dn0FpwV_OZAgBo9mxYhIL8WvdP456XrNwFSg1k1gMeU5pGBmrFIRMmDZq3Hjqb-bpXcrPM_9P93oB5MXm-pBX7x3czc4l-dO47XGvl7gZ3hdSe4JG_X4-mRSDPHxAG9M_nFBurcqCk65fFMu5EzKde7enRqTbdcrbTBGB7dSuRzLpAPpw544eWTHABFbSCOoQws6lPZrv1aKEnTkmrtJG3Dq5A7HOV8eE4A3sLzRntlUV8PZoEzYN-FzaElmf70ZEeCdkf0j9WUsAWbOdOxSG_bhbYN8M18mIof3bhyj2TrPvBIi1d9syIALPgtgyjbVMD6-M71qflQ-KpNtpi_w2sbKYMsj2U9gZuYhTPacl2CyFqh5-qzX1Ifi6RX901lnIyInxCXWmfiHF_vOlLFhacExsjo_2IZhfk0JcWGQx7-O90DZtdUj3FMdwu5m3Jmbi-SftsA9w-G9o0-vtSwOSq4HoA2X5G11OIIlXrD4Z6JXzO4gra1ueMxTedY-o9EgBU1kwM%3D)

| | Friend,

I hope you are enjoying the beautiful summer weather so far! With all of the summer plans many of us have coming up, it can be easy to forget that ballots drop for the Primary Election in just a few weeks! That means that today, of all days, is a beautiful day to [contribute to our campaign](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=30eb000f26&e=77eef70c61) and [make a difference in King County.](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=08d1595601&e=77eef70c61)

This month's reporting period is __one of the most important of the year.__ Next time our campaign files a monthly report, the general election will have already begun!

With so much at stake in this election,[ would you be willing to rush a quick donation of $50, $35, or even $25 to help us reach our reporting goal?](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=8fdc903781&e=77eef70c61)
**\---------------**
**[DONATE NOW!](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=82907dae2a&e=77eef70c61)**
**\---------------**
As we head into the general election, we want to have as strong a showing as possible because this campaign is King County's last line of defense **_against_** :
* Out-of-control politicians in both Seattle and Olympia **raising your taxes **at unprecedented levels,
* Out-of-touch attempts to **defund law enforcement,**
* And extreme activist-driven Seattle policies that **increase** your cost-of-living while **decreasing** community safety.

If you would be willing to [make a quick donation](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=11c2ed4cfb&e=77eef70c61) before the end of the day today, it would go a long way toward ensuring that we are on the best possible footing heading into the general election.

It's a beautiful day to make a difference in King County!

Thank you for your support!
Reagan Dunn

"**UNT Dallas, UNTHSC name sole finalists for president,** " Dallas Morning News' **Talia Richman** - "UNT Dallas and the UNT Health Science Center will soon have new university leaders.

System Chancellor **Michael R. Williams** named sole finalists for the positions: **Warren von Eschenbach** was tapped to permanently take over the UNT Dallas school while **Kirk Calhoun** was picked for the Fort Worth-based Health Science Center.

Both were interim leaders before the University of North Texas System regents unanimously selected them as sole finalists during a special meeting.

"I am confident they will continue to serve with distinction -- fostering academic excellence, driving innovation, and serving the students and communities entrusted to our care," Williams [said in a Friday letter.](https://substack.com/redirect/8615b5f8-367d-4356-891a-3aa83d4e597f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/2a3650fa-a054-45ce-a7e0-c39eedf71e17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Since April 2024, von Eschenbach has served as UNT Dallas' interim president. He launched the university's first Center for Innovation in Teaching and Learning and pushed strategies to grow enrollment, officials said. He has more than a decade of experience in various university leadership roles.

He will succeed **Bob Mong** , who retired after leading the southern Dallas-area school for nine years. Mong joined the university after a long career in journalism that included serving as editor of _The Dallas Morning News._

Calhoun has more than three decades of experience in medicine and higher education leadership. He's held the interim role at the UNTHSC since January, following his retirement as president of the University of Texas at Tyler.

He began his tenure as the Fort Worth-based health science center was under scrutiny over a now-suspended program's handling of unclaimed bodies.

An investigation by NBC News found the UNTHSC's Willed Body Program routinely used bodies for research or training without consent or approval from surviving family members.

In January, the system's regents accepted the resignation of former president **Sylvia Trent-Adams** by "mutual agreement."" [DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/71c75b4e-c8d2-4b43-8316-ad30a9539918?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

System Chancellor Michael R. Williams named sole finalists for the positions: Warren von Eschenbach was tapped to permanently take over the UNT Dallas school while Kirk Calhoun was picked for the Fort Worth-based Health Science Center. Both were interim leaders before the University of North Texas System regents unanimously selected them as sole finalists during a special meeting. "I am confident they will continue to serve with distinction -- fostering academic excellence, driving innovation, and serving the students and communities entrusted to our care," Williams Since April 2024, von Eschenbach has served as UNT Dallas' interim president. He launched the university's first Center for Innovation in Teaching and Learning and pushed strategies to grow enrollment, officials said. He has more than a decade of experience in various university leadership roles. He will succeed Bob Mong , who retired after leading the southern Dallas-area school for nine years. Mong joined the university after a long career in journalism that included serving as editor of The Dallas Morning News. Calhoun has more than three decades of experience in medicine and higher education leadership. He's held the interim role at the UNTHSC since January, following his retirement as president of the University of Texas at Tyler. He began his tenure as the Fort Worth-based health science center was under scrutiny over a now-suspended program's handling of unclaimed bodies. An investigation by NBC News found the UNTHSC's Willed Body Program routinely used bodies for research or training without consent or approval from surviving family members. In January, the system's regents accepted the resignation of former president Sylvia Trent-Adams by "mutual agreement."" subject: My “what”

body:
A lot of people don’t know what an average Democrat fights for.
#
We need a vision that's not _just_ anti-Trump. This is a position I've long held.
We actually need a positive, affirmative vision for this country, and be willing to take risks, and vote on real things, and _actually tell people what we're fighting for._
A lot of people don't know what an average Democrat fights for.
This is where we have an opportunity to fight for minimum wage increases, to fight for guaranteed health care, to fight for something that's actually worthwhile.
Like in New York City: we just experienced a near historic heat wave — people stood in line in the hot sun, no air conditioning to vote for Zohran.
**You need to have a vision that's worth standing in the hot sun for hours to vote for.** People are not going to do that with only ‘being upset.’
It's important for us to hold the corruption of this administration accountable, but we also have to have an alternative vision.
And it can't just be, “Not that.” If it's _not that_ , then _what_ is it?
For me, my “what” is **raising the federal minimum wage to a living wage.**
My “what” is **guaranteed healthcare for every American** and catching up with the rest of the modern world.
My “what” is **making public colleges and universities tuition free.**
My “what” is actually having a **real path to citizenship** in the United States.
That’s why this movement is so important: we’re fighting for each and every one of these issues, from universal healthcare to getting money out of our politics.
[ Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250630-2.JWTE6O&refcode=em20250630-9209-P_FND_CTR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9209%2E2526796%2E4DK7bY)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day. [1]Powered By People

Beto kicked off his weekend by hosting a town hall Friday night in San
Antonio, with Joaquín Castro, Ron Nirenberg, and James Talarico. The
auditorium was packed and the energy was electric—people showed up to
fight for the future of our state and our country.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20250630.-__X6A&refcode=ema20250630-240196&t=1001&akid=240196%2E444211%2EZrfQI2 ]Beto O'Rourke speaking into a microphone in front of hundreds of

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20250630.-__X6A&refcode=ema20250630-240196&t=1002&akid=240196%2E444211%2EZrfQI2 ]Ron Nirenberg, James Talarico, Joaquín Castro, and Beto O'Rourke
standing in front of a stage with supporters behind them.

Then on Saturday, Beto traveled to Laredo for a town hall:

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20250630.-__X6A&refcode=ema20250630-240196&t=1003&akid=240196%2E444211%2EZrfQI2 ]Beto O'Rourke speaking into a microphone in the center of a crowd of
seated Texans.

Beto answered questions about the future of the Democratic Party and how
we need a Democratic Party that meets with the people and isn’t sterilely
driven by consultants. The Old Guard of the Democratic Party had their
shot in 2024 and they blew it. We want to thank them for their service and

# Trump admin officially accuses Harvard of civil rights violations for antisemitic activity on campus
The Trump Administration **[officially accused Harvard University of violating civil rights laws](https://substack.com/redirect/f82ce53d-c0dd-4f17-8dce-439c7159cfe7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for being "deliberately indifferent" or even a "willful participant" in antisemitism on campus, threatening to pull federal funding.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f82ce53d-c0dd-4f17-8dce-439c7159cfe7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The Trump administration has formally accused Harvard University** of violating civil rights laws by failing to adequately address antisemitism on campus, threatening to revoke all federal funding. A federal task force claimed Harvard was "in some cases deliberately indifferent, and in others has been a willful participant in anti-Semitic harassment."
* **What did the Admin find?** \- A 57-page report by the Department of Health and Human Services' Office for Civil Rights cited findings from over 50 listening sessions with more than 500 Jewish students, revealing that 60% reported experiencing discrimination, and 44% felt mentally unsafe on campus.
* **Specific incidents detailed in the report included** students being spat on for wearing yarmulkes, harassed with "heil Hitler" chants, and stalked--allegations that the task force claims were largely ignored by university officials.
* **Trump said negotiations with Harvard may yield a resolution soon:** "We have been working closely with Harvard, and it is very possible that a Deal will be announced over the next week or so," he posted June 20 on Truth Social, adding the university "appears to be committed to doing what is right."
* **In response to the investigation,** Harvard revealed its Antisemitism and Anti-Israeli Bias Report, as well as an update on disciplinary policies pertaining to respectful dialogue on campus.

# Hero father leaps off Disney cruise ship to save his daughter after horrifying fall
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/336ab1ff-88c4-449a-bad5-a55c1d5c5c91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A father**[jumped into the ocean and saved his daughter from drowning](https://substack.com/redirect/336ab1ff-88c4-449a-bad5-a55c1d5c5c91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after she fell off a Disney cruise ship Sunday.
* **The father jumped into the ocean from the Disney Dream cruise ship** to rescue his young daughter after she fell overboard from the fourth deck while en route from Florida to the Bahamas on Sunday, according to eyewitnesses.
* **" A girl fell overboard from the 4th deck and her dad went in after her,"** fellow passenger Kevin Furuta posted on Facebook, describing the dramatic rescue scene.
* **The father held onto his daughter and treaded water for about 20 minutes** before both were safely rescued by a swiftly deployed yellow rescue boat, as horrified vacationers watched from the ship.
* **" We commend our Crew Members for their exceptional skills **and prompt actions, which ensured the safe return of both guests to the ship within minutes," a Disney Cruise Line spokesperson told _USA Today_ , emphasizing the effectiveness of the company's safety protocols.
