body:
We can only keep up the fight with your support.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250630-1&t=1&akid=2323%2E587540%2EiACuID)
Peter, I hear the same kind of frustrated reaction to Democratic fundraising a lot:
**_“Why are you asking me for $5 when Trump is destroying our country and Democrats aren’t doing anything about it?”_**
I can’t speak for every group, but I do know what sets Leaders We Deserve apart.
We represent a generation of people who walked out of their schools, marching with millions of their peers to demand action on gun violence and mass shootings.
Young people are at the forefront of progressive movements, fighting for solutions on issues like gun reform, climate change, student debt, and Gaza, to name a few.
Now, these same young leaders are old enough to actually run for political office, right at the time when we need a massive movement of young people in power.
**Leaders We Deserve exists to transform these movements into political power.** Running for office is more expensive than ever — and these young leaders need our support to help lead their movements into state legislatures and Congress. We know that the billionaire class isn’t showing up to bankroll these campaigns, so it’s not an exaggeration to say they can’t win these fights without grassroots support.
**Right now, we’ve got a major end-of-quarter deadline TONIGHT at MIDNIGHT.**
**[Peter, can you contribute $5 to power our transformational movement?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250630_1_transformational?refcode=em20250630-2323&amount=5&refcode2=2323_587540_iACuID&akid=2323%2E587540%2EiACuID)**
**The young candidates that Leaders We Deserve supports are gamechangers. They will revitalize the Democratic Party and revolutionize our government.**
Our candidates are leading the fight to rebuild our political system. And they aren’t rebuilding the same political system that brought us school shootings, climate change, and everything that younger generations have to deal with in America.
They’re building something better — a system that actually works for the people.
I believe that a big part of the answer to Donald Trump is building a movement of young people who will take back the reins of our government from the far right.
**Young people are up to this challenge.** If history has taught us anything, it's that great generations aren’t born, they’re made in the crucible of awful circumstances.
So when you give a donation to Leaders We Deserve, you aren’t just throwing out money at the status quo. You are investing in a different vision for what’s possible.
We only have a few hours left to reach our $100,000 end-of-quarter goal. I know we’ll get there before midnight with this extraordinary team’s continued support.
**[Please — pitch in $5 now to join our movement and fight for our future.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250630_1_transformational?refcode=em20250630-2323&amount=5&refcode2=2323_587540_iACuID&akid=2323%2E587540%2EiACuID)**
We can only do this work with your support. I deeply appreciate your generosity.
Thank you,
David Hogg

represent.

body:
[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1001&akid=250%2E1086043%2EBCEhbH ]Wes Moore for Governor[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1002&akid=250%2E1086043%2EBCEhbH ]Wes Moore for Governor

Peter, it’s Dawn Moore, First Lady of Maryland.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250630-2?refcode=em-20250630-2&refcode2=250_1086043_BCEhbH&akid=250%2E1086043%2EBCEhbH ]Dawn and Wes

You might know Wes as the governor. But to me, he’s my ride or die. No
matter the challenge we face, I know he’s always got my back. And I have
his!

I’ve worked in fundraising and know what it means to have to hit goals.
Wes is facing a big one: the end of the fundraising quarter on June 30th.
That’s why I’m asking you:

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250630-2?refcode=em-20250630-2&refcode2=250_1086043_BCEhbH&akid=250%2E1086043%2EBCEhbH ]Can you chip in $5 or any amount today so we can keep Wes
fighting for Maryland? Your support has a direct impact on this movement.

As Wes’s wife of 18 years, I know he’s feeling the pressure right now.
Reaching this fundraising goal is key to his mission of continuing to make
this Maryland’s decade. He cares so much about serving the people of our
state.

But I also know that with your support, we’ll cross the finish line. We’ll
continue proving to the nation that Maryland is ready to lead.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250630-2?refcode=em-20250630-2&refcode2=250_1086043_BCEhbH&akid=250%2E1086043%2EBCEhbH ]So can I count on you to chip in $5 – or whatever you
can – to his re-election campaign today?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250630-2?amount=5&refcode=em-20250630-2&refcode2=250_1086043_BCEhbH&akid=250%2E1086043%2EBCEhbH ]Donate $5 ››

Thank you. Hitting our fundraising goal is just the good news Wes needs to
end the day.

In gratitude,

Dawn Moore

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.wesmoore.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=250%2E1086043%2EBCEhbH

We’re sure you’re getting tons of emails right now, asking for money. That’s because tonight is a major fundraising deadline for campaigns, and everyone is doing everything they can to get money in the door.

name: Stasha Rhodes, United for Democracy
subject: Taking on Leonard Leo
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
The Federalist Society spent decades behind the scenes reshaping the Supreme Court. We’re putting SCOTUS front and center too. | |
---
Peter, The extreme, right-wing Federalist Society’s tentacles are so deep in our court system that Trump is still appointing their members—even after publicly denouncing the group for not doing enough to stack our system with MAGA judges. **Despite Trump’s complaints, the Leonard Leo-funded group has spent decades and billions of dollars completely reshaping America’s justice system behind the scenes to work for corporations and the wealthy and against the people.** Leo has made questionable connections between large donors and judges, some of whom now sit on the Supreme Court and enjoy perks offered by those same connections. The Federalist Society pushed extremist conservatives at every level of the judiciary. The network worked to elect those who would appoint and install exactly who they wanted in courts across the country. The left doesn’t have an equivalent to the Federalist Society (fortunately). **But we do have groups like United for Democracy, who are putting the Supreme Court front and center.** Instead of attempting to install extremists at every level of our judiciary, we’re fighting to take back our democracy for the people, hold the courts accountable to the rule of law, and end corruption in our judiciary. [**We can’t afford to let the Federalist Society continue its takeover of our judiciary without a strong, coordinated answer. That’s why United for Democracy is building a coalition of groups and activists across the country. Chip in $5 today to help us put fixing the Supreme Court front and center.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvo61CKMs7a9VT-QhG35Kwcbtp9FEjcM3QAs9Hf0Mb1gYsJ4ylC_6myfS6Yem8KbGzTbcNVrCoKuppxxHJ7E5imZytSdvveT-hnXk9h1PgVG6R-90w-CmghaKedq45fKb1wXSNvHCgTHH3mVS7l9rqJTZonZWkBk3vS3qQ8qaWZ6N1GcF0uA8JT8cqAtZ-cGwwl6_ca2joD03dy66SGwIa1vBJJyYh6Pdcmxbo-xNwjd8ORjCi3grE5efjzrnfkGFo8C7QSgK2fB4coOR4c-uch5s6zRu1j5T2pIx1u2CjHKA/4hs/I6MNficIS8esuBlHyswJHA/h0/h001.wVY42H9rPFdFfsMD19dOhbqTBqAOaGRoZ3u1cc7QCDU) [DONATE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvo61CKMs7a9VT-QhG35Kwcbtp9FEjcM3QAs9Hf0Mb1gUQoOcUWwCkroaPppJi55xr310z2RPAfLEy10nGo135RyPEMrpRjH2hz9A5ps3IxEhnt2uReGjj-Bkmbg5_0gd9oYzNTkbBXfWTqyAD32bfqm7zuzKhr7jc6wMwryaOnqPmV7fL0Ph3O15L7k1SUoyZoXROLmIHlIOeaQPJYSs9pCRa98aKaHYzvJ3Oheo9Jb5d-VqKKpgs4yeGvOthPAUi12sc56VXZRSBxuf5UZQ04Y1r_jHBrQDQRGVyddi4Ahg/4hs/I6MNficIS8esuBlHyswJHA/h1/h001.bkI8tKkLNk0_riqQa98d5cs-yZazn1gwk8TwLuhWUsc) Trump may have attacked Leo and the Federalist Society when their extremely MAGA judges didn’t rule exactly the way he wanted them to. **But according to Politico, the Federalist Society isn’t going anywhere.** In fact, the Senate Judiciary Committee voted last week on a slate of five Federalist Society judicial nominees. The White House has already nominated and confirmed hundreds of Federalist Society judges. **Those of us who care about defending democracy need to fight back against the Federalist Society—and we have to do it now.** It’s going to take all of us working together to undo the decades of behind-the-scenes damage Leo and his cronies have done. clean_body: The Federalist Society spent decades behind the scenes reshaping the Supreme Court. We’re putting SCOTUS front and center too. | | Peter, The extreme, right-wing Federalist Society’s tentacles are so deep in our court system that Trump is still appointing their members—even after publicly denouncing the group for not doing enough to stack our system with MAGA judges. Despite Trump’s complaints, the Leonard Leo-funded group has spent decades and billions of dollars completely reshaping America’s justice system behind the scenes to work for corporations and the wealthy and against the people. Leo has made questionable connections between large donors and judges, some of whom now sit on the Supreme Court and enjoy perks offered by those same connections. The Federalist Society pushed extremist conservatives at every level of the judiciary. The network worked to elect those who would appoint and install exactly who they wanted in courts across the country. The left doesn’t have an equivalent to the Federalist Society (fortunately). But we do have groups like United for Democracy, who are putting the Supreme Court front and center. Instead of attempting to install extremists at every level of our judiciary, we’re fighting to take back our democracy for the people, hold the courts accountable to the rule of law, and end corruption in our judiciary. Trump may have attacked Leo and the Federalist Society when their extremely MAGA judges didn’t rule exactly the way he wanted them to. But according to Politico, the Federalist Society isn’t going anywhere. In fact, the Senate Judiciary Committee voted last week on a slate of five Federalist Society judicial nominees. The White House has already nominated and confirmed hundreds of Federalist Society judges. Those of us who care about defending democracy need to fight back against the Federalist Society—and we have to do it now. It’s going to take all of us working together to undo the decades of behind-the-scenes damage Leo and his cronies have done. Especially since the Federalist Society is so deeply baked into conservative legal circles. name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: Emailing you one more time
body:
Hi friend,
I know we’ve reached out a few times recently, and I’m sorry if it feels like a lot. But with national Republicans flooding the airwaves with attack ads this early in my district, I can’t stay quiet. Not if we are going to win.
We’re just a few hours away from tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline – one that will shape the trajectory of our re-election – and I need to be honest with you: we’re still short of our goal. Could you chip in $3 before midnight to help us close the gap?
**Here’s a good link to donate:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kmr-q2-2025](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110585008/554797706/846650059?refcode=em-6.30.25-2-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmZlOTc4Zi1mZDU1LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=l-GX713cPjnl5E2yqdnRlxuCHYoVnroOup7nXMjRk2Y=)**
Here’s the reality: We’re facing the largest GOP ad blitz against any House Democrat – more than $600,000 from Mike Johnson’s super PAC, plus nearly $150,000 more from Trump’s, totaling almost $1 million.
They’re doing this right now because they know MI-08 is one of the toughest districts in the country for a Democrat to win. Republicans are hoping to weaken our campaign early and flip this seat before voters are even paying attention. By chipping in now, you’re sending a signal to them and anybody thinking about challenging us that this coalition is determined to hold MI-08 Blue.
So friend, if you can, please send in a donation before tonight’s fundraising deadline. Every dollar helps, but $3 from you would be a huge help toward meeting this goal.
**Here’s that link again:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kmr-q2-2025](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110585011/554797720/846650059?refcode=em-6.30.25-2-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmZlOTc4Zi1mZDU1LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=l-GX713cPjnl5E2yqdnRlxuCHYoVnroOup7nXMjRk2Y=)**
Gratefully,
kmr

Kristen for Michigan
P.O. Box 854
Bay City, MI 48707
United States

Hey, this is Vivek Ramaswamy, and I'd like to share a personal story with you.
When I was in middle school, my father got laid off from his factory job at the General Electric plant in Evendale, Ohio. He was one of the hardest workers there, but like thousands of other good men and women, he was laid off without warning.
Most people would complain, whine, and stomp their feet, saying, "It's not fair!".
But not MY dad. He didn't cry about victimhood or racism.
Instead, he picked himself up, dusted himself off, got a new job, and enrolled in night school law classes for the next four years.
But because money was tight, he and my mother couldn't afford childcare. Every day after middle school, my dad would pick me up and we'd drive for 45 minutes to the University of Kentucky across the river.
I'd sit in the back of his law school classes every night.
Most kids my age would hate the idea of spending all day at school just to go to ANOTHER school at night. But not me.
I was FASCINATED, learning about the Constitution, the principles of law, and Supreme Court decisions.
So why do I even share this story with you in the first place?
Because that time in my life taught me a lesson I've never forgotten: Every hardship is an opportunity - if you're willing to work for it.
That mindset is the foundation of my campaign.
I don't believe in a culture of victimhood. I believe in the American Dream. I believe in merit over DEI. In hard work over handouts. In family, faith, and responsibility, not grievance and blame.
Right now, we have a real opportunity to reverse Radical Leftist policies. An opportunity to show how the nuclear family is the best form of governance. An opportunity to showcase how capitalism lifts people out of poverty. An opportunity to reinstate the American Dream.
And I know that you're one of the dedicated American Patriots who believe in that vision.
That's why I need you with me, Fellow American.
[If you can, please consider donating $10 to my campaign for governor today. I need all the help I can get to restore the American Dream for Ohioans and Americans alike.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cf1eb4ed4a23444db6c2da3d573b0d2c&_e=r7VaCH29U9DUG0XxPf1L0ebTVmrvExc3DxAt7hEIhwrrkGzGRWdpmq80mj8q6e9kza2ieEN7zR_bcGrwO4JXpvenzspEzQ0Fazjkiop90jaxbekrSENjkbKm_tKvJ0c-wHfYPlgroUVirHKywvPjAF1oOgftJvzk73WLwOUhwWp6yu8fyneYHJCmpBiOU5o0wKeyzTMmJHbl0AbMqwOlNR1LpQ2yFMpeyBI-o-EP4C-Bjafg1JK_t7pVMV2EgJmGZNSewD8C3YLejDIcuDP3KfIV5imWSDTjmEb7B6qfGxWu-1NrVW4TCmubYTf47G61AEuOvQbhP0Us-8HkMZQGFLq2U3E8P0QSKiQS3g2RtCCkd590raS5VQzXLXKfoWUPJc3aYuLuse2_ThZVMSoX1QF0ujDnTqJzbATmqqMhVK5Om4UJM2yWyxDEPNesQ9cG-LLxCQxXxs6IlZvgynijjRGV925k8ScEh4q6pp1TKIQKEZsgsTXpnZojz30FZmAS3eNdRFYR__siyv8qBKH15NGsS2KxHGS3vNt70DFdpWLTExnx0RPJrE4CqeaAbGglIaas19X0vQh8VNe5HUEkd6H_jDb3bD5pxJwvfer1TAZT54tXF5J8XBv7Q_QeR7vv5fiyy4IjJY8ifo4xmXXRUMct_cXKL0eqfbQXaNQAi9NdGj0IjDteZrHRdn-E5CqN2cpnFk9DJ2hiQLeo3E8wi8ZdhZsjGFX_h7cwY4qxAFSzFqkUbH8XRKykfuo-9hbem7AWAz_DLMhC4l66nzK2QA%3D%3D)

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I never lost my voice
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
#

Friend,
14 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.
With a lot of practice, I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there — pushing me, supporting me, and making me laugh. Now, it’s my turn to help him.
Together, we know a thing or two about tough times. And I can tell you one thing for sure: This is one of those times.
All year long, Donald Trump and his allies have attacked Mark’s reputation, his character, even his loyalty to this country. Mark has spent his entire life in service to the United States, and it’s difficult to see people you’ve never met tearing him down like that.
He needs our help to hold his ground and fight back. So, I’m asking:
[**Can you chip in $3 – or anything you can afford – to Mark as he takes on Trump and his Administration? It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up poor, raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.

**But I felt called to tell my story. Warts and all.** I felt led to speak out because I think millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.

_As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. _

[_**Read Emily’s message below, then pitch in here before our midnight FEC deadline to keep her fighting for us in Congress.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110587371/554802568/1131891713?amount=6&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.06.30_EOQ4Pride_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDVhOTM1MS0wMTU2LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VE6maHLx3uH48d30TFXxJE0z5n_yXctBaEM3aBusTX0=) _Previous Message from Emily Randall:_
* * *
Peter— Seattle Pride was the first Pride event I ever attended. Twenty years ago, I had just come out, and I decided to volunteer at the festival while I was home from college. Today, I led the Seattle Pride parade as its Grand Marshall. It was a full-circle moment that I think my 19-year-old self would be proud of. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110587374/554802569/1131891713?amount=6&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.06.30_EOQ4Pride_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDVhOTM1MS0wMTU2LWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VE6maHLx3uH48d30TFXxJE0z5n_yXctBaEM3aBusTX0=) Today’s celebration was also a powerful reminder of just how important and impactful it is to be with community. Queer joy is an act of resistance, something worth celebrating and nurturing, perhaps more now than ever. Since my very first Pride, so much has changed. Our region, like many others, has seen a proliferation of Pride celebrations and Pride clubs and GSAs in schools – young people today have grown up with marriage equality as the law of the land. But today queer communities everywhere are facing attack after attack. 597 anti-LGBTQ bills have been introduced in state legislatures across the US in the first six months of this year. The Republican-controlled Supreme Court just upheld Tennessee’s Ban on health care for trans Americans. The Trump Administration is withholding federal funding from states that do safeguard queer communities. These are serious threats. As the first openly LGBTQ+ person to represent Washington in Congress, and a co-chair of the Equality Caucus, I am doing everything in my power to fight back. We won’t let MAGA extremists write the rules for our future. Not when we have the power to shape it ourselves, not when we fight on with hope and determination. I was honored to sit down with Bree Coven from the _Seattle Times_ a few weeks back to talk about this fight, what Pride means to me, and more. body:
#

Peter, we’re reaching out again today to ask you if there’s ANYTHING we can say to convince you to make your first online donation to Jon Ossoff’s re-election campaign before our critical FEC deadline in just a few hours?
If you already know the stakes of this race and the importance of this deadline and are ready to contribute now, use this link: [**https://act.electjon.com/go/June-FEC**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-june25.2OdyOr&refcode=em250630-2-f&t=1&akid=523%2E5691347%2E6qbxiA)
Otherwise, here's the deal:
This is the first FEC fundraising deadline since Marjorie Taylor Greene and Brian Kemp announced they’re not running, and it's a big one.
Because when it ends, we're legally required to publicly report not just what we've raised, but also the number of donations we've received.
Everyone will be watching: From Donald Trump, to the Republican Party and their Super PACs, to the press and more. They'll want to see if we have what it takes to defend this seat.
[**So please, chip in today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-june25.2OdyOr&refcode=em250630-2-f&t=2&akid=523%2E5691347%2E6qbxiA)
Give $5 because Jon is the only Democratic incumbent up for re-election in a state Trump won.
Give $5 to fight back against the hundreds of millions of dollars Republican Super PACs and MAGA megadonors will likely spend to win this race.
Give $5 because our campaign is funded by lots of individual donations from people giving what they can, when they can.
**We know that $5 may not seem like it can take on Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and the entire Republican Party. But when lots and lots of people are chipping in, it adds up fast. So please:**
[**Rush a $5 contribution directly to Jon Ossoff's campaign. We're looking for lots and lots of donations before our official FEC fundraising deadline at midnight.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-june25.2OdyOr&refcode=em250630-2-f&t=3&akid=523%2E5691347%2E6qbxiA)

body:

subject: This is my least favorite part of being in Congress.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nikki for Congress
body:
Hi friend, it’s Nikki. Thanks for sticking with me – I promise this is the last time I’ll reach out before tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline.

I’ll be frank: Asking my supporters like you to chip in their hard-earned money toward my campaign is my _least_ favorite part of this job.

But it’s critical to keep IL-13 blue. Especially now that the national GOP is sending baseless attacks my way in a thinly-veiled effort to turn this seat red.

**I disrupted the GOP machine when I flipped this seat and became the first woman to ever represent this district in Congress. And as you can imagine, they’ve held a grudge ever since.**

It doesn’t stop me from doing what I was brought to Congress to do – work tirelessly to make life better for working families. But if these last few months have shown us anything, it’s that the MAGA agenda doesn’t believe in uplifting the middle class.

It’s not right, and while I’m doing everything in my power to push back, we simply can’t hold this administration accountable without the House majority.

A Democratic House starts with keeping this seat blue. Only three seats separate control, and early support is critical to our success. So before our FEC deadline expires at midnight, will you chip in $3 to stand with me?

body:
We can't have a healthy climate without a healthy democracy

| Donald Trump's march toward authoritarianism was in plain sight this month. He deployed armed forces to the streets of LA. Ordered military strikes without congressional authority. ### **THE BLUE LETTER**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/05586582-46f1-403c-9092-35f01ccd0262?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let me walk you through something that no one in the mainstream press seems to be talking about--but it's right there, smacking us painfully in the face like Trump trying to pronounce "anonymous."
Putin's _pissed._
No, I mean like really pissed. Like "you were supposed to deliver Ukraine on a silver platter and instead you gave me a drone strike humiliating the Russian military 2,800 miles from Kyiv" kind of pissed.
And it's not just frustration. It's _disappointment_ --which, as every authoritarian toddler like Trump knows, is so much worse. Because when Vlad's disappointed? He starts shopping for a new American President. Even if he doesn't have the ability to do it with polonium tea.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/acc5df24-fbd4-435e-abec-477bc19a34c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let's rewind, shall we? Trump rose to power with the _**full backing of Russia**_. That's not conjecture. That's not a "Russia hoax." That's fact as established in The Mueller Report, the Senate Intelligence Committee run by a GOP Senator and something like 15-16 foreign intelligence agencies. _The only thing Trump changed in the 2016 GOP platform? The part where we 'd defend Ukraine._
Gee, I just can't think who might have wanted that in there?!? Could it possibly rhyme with Badamir Lootin? Everything else--the usual open season for right-wing theocrats, supply-side snake handlers, those concerned about ant-white racism and hedge fund vampires--remained the same.
Fast forward. Putin invades Ukraine expecting Trump, his loyal little poodle, to take care of it. I mean, they installed him for a reason, right? _He had one job_!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8d8e4bcb-0fad-4810-acbb-771528e97cb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_**The bromance is more like Trump on his knees in Helsinki**_

Only problem? Trump flamed out in 2020 because he he ignored COVID, screwed up the economy and is basically a schmuck. So Biden came in, and Ukrainian President Zelensky--who Trump laughably tried to bully into submission--turned out to be _Churchillian_.
He not only outmaneuvering Trump tot the point where Trump got impeached (one of two!). But also totally wrecked the oft-topless-while-on-horseback Russian dictator with $47,000 worth of drones and trucks--a serious Mission-Impossible kinda plan with some serious Mission-Impossible-kinda courage.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3f4cc8bc-0d6d-4743-bf84-621c22851460?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Putin was left looking like a Bond villain with a receding hairline and no plan B. Elon Musk, basically..
So when Trump recently approved U.S. strikes on Iranian nuclear sites--_after_ being told by Putin and Medvedev, in very clear language, not to, [but just couldn't help himself](https://substack.com/redirect/b9726724-d6c6-48d0-a891-c3fb40582688?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--well, now Trump was 0-2. (Not the mention the sanctions he hasn't gotten removed).
And that was the moment. Putin and his Lauren-Sanchez-Botox-regime mini-me, Medvedevm came out publicly, accused the U.S. of launching an "unprovoked war," and made it crystal clear: Trump disobeyed orders. Some more from Medvedev:
> "Trump started a new war, and expects us to pretend it didn't happen?"
Ruh roh. You see, being smarter than Trump after chugging a bottle of Stolichnaya, then still smarter after cracking it over his own head, Putin knows Trump ran on "no new wars." So he had Medy refute Trump's exact phrasing to fire up some piss and vinegar in a MAGA world already beset by division over the bombing. With stalwart MAGAs [such as MTG, Steve Bannon, Rand Paul, Tom Massie and Candace Owens furious](https://substack.com/redirect/e1092f5a-7430-48a8-b892-500c7675fb3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
And if anyone knows what it looks like when someone hands you divorce papers, that would be the serially married-yet-perpetually-porn-starred Donald Trump. This time, however, the papers are coming from guy who likes to break up with his boy-toys from 5th floor hotel windows.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/169220b4-ddd7-4a6c-823f-90bc0779ee2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now, I'm not saying Putin's about to send Trump on a magic carpet ride sans rug--he doesn't want a nuclear war, after all. Though if you saw Trump's angry response, that "Putin better be careful," well, let's just say that won't go over well in Moscow.
And Vlad has other weapons. Many, many cultural, economic, and world-chaos-causing weapons. He's also got options. And soon, he may jus hold some _auditions_. Or Kremlin Casting Calls.
You've got JD Vance, who'd probably crawl over MAGA hats with emptied Trump diapers to polish Putin's boots with a Made-in-China "Don't Tread on Me" flag. Tulsi Gabbard, who might as well be broadcasting direct from the Kremlin basement. And for all we know, she might be.
There's Marjorie Taylor Greene, the Putin fangirl with a penchant for crazy conspiracies, who when not dodging Rothschild spacer laser beams that would make Flash Gordon jealous, get into her CrossFit fascism. And don't forget Elon Musk, who's somewhere between Lex Luthor and your emotionally stunted cousin who who drinks diesel fuel thinks he's a genius because he read _Atlas Shrugged_ once in college.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/02731c4c-f6d4-4a7f-a30b-11714ed68201?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is the kind of palace intrigue that doesn't show up on cable news chyrons, because corporate news doesn't like to share...news. But it's real. And very much not difficult to put together if you have any ability to connect dots, understand the language behind the language of false diplomacy and can understand things like context and tonal change.
Putin gave Trump his big chance. Sure, they knew he was nuts, but the kinda nuts that Putin, and old KGB hand, knew could redound to their favor by ripping this country apart emotionally. And Putin was right. But, he also counted on Trump to execute. Big miscalculation there, Pootie.
So now the Kremlin just may be circling the field like a recruiter at a fascist football game.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/23174cdd-f515-4cb1-961d-4f6c3ef2d60d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And look--this isn't some lefty fantasy. I think this split likely helps America a lot, but when it's silly men with sillier egos and weapons of mass destruction, there's always danger. And Trump, often after a period of blowing his shpadoinkle, comes back and apologizes, so this rupture may be repaired.
Putin doesn't tend to be very big on forgiving disobedience. Sadly, in a thoroughly corrupt GOP and propagandized Far Left, there are always more marionettes to be had.
But, next time you hear Trump screaming that _everyone 's out to get him_--Iran, Israel, every platypus, his ex-lawyers, the deep state, Tiffany, the Hague--remember this: He's not just unhinged. Well, he is unhinged, actually, but not about this particular thing.
On this, he's _cornered._ And when a pathological narcissist like Trump--with something like 20 other emotional challenges the DSM-5 specifically lays out--is cornered, he lashes out at all those around him, and all those not around him.
That's how wars can start. And that's how democracies can fall.
If Putin is truly done with Trump, and looking to install someone even more obedient, we had better brace for what comes next--because there's no shortage of right-wing bootlickers in line to audition in front of Putin, enter Stage Far Right.

Hi Peter,
Today is the last day of our second fundraising quarter of 2025. Peter, we set a goal at the beginning of June to raise $10,000 through our digital fundraising program before EOQ (today), and as of this morning, we are just about $1,200 away from reaching our goal! This grassroots team has raised nearly $9,000 this month, and I could not be more grateful.
Now, we are so close to reaching our goal. Peter, can you chip in any amount before midnight tonight to help us close this budget gap? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-email]

I’ll be frank—we are facing challenging times in Washington. Just last week, the Supreme Court ruled that Medicaid patients cannot sue to enforce their right to choose a qualified provider in Medina vs. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic, and this week the Republicans are focused on passing Trump’s so-called ‘Big, Beautiful Bill’, which is really a “Big, Beautiful Betrayal” that will kick people off of their health care while cutting taxes for the wealthiest among us. I am doing all that I can to fight back against this harmful legislation, and am determined to keep up our campaign operations so we can be ready for anything thrown our way in 2026.
Peter, fundraising is the last thing I want to be doing at this moment, but the stronger the fundraising numbers we have during this off year, the less likely this race is to garner the attention of national Republicans. subject: We're making plans to help where we're needed most
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
Continuing this work is going to take ALL of us, Peter. Peter,

We’ve seen what happens when we come together to support good candidates — _here in Kentucky and all across this country:_

**We elect leaders who listen to their constituents, who put people ahead of politics, and who work every single day to lift up their communities.** That’s what this work is all about — ensuring every child has a shot at a good education, every family can access affordable healthcare, and every worker is treated with dignity.

It’s about electing people who care more about doing what’s right than scoring political points. I’m proud of the progress we’ve made, but I know there’s so much more we can do, together. There are races ahead where our support could be the difference between a leader who lifts folks up, and one who leaves them behind.

clean_body: | | | Peter, It's Zohran Mamdani. We did it. Last Tuesday, we made history. What they said was impossible is now our reality: Our movement beat the establishment. People all across the country seeing what we’ve done, and they know that voters want something more than the broken politics and broken promises of the past. None of this would have been possible without the sacrifices of the more than 50,000 volunteers and 20,000 donors who made our movement what it is today. On Tuesday we handed the politics of status quo a monumental defeat. But our fight isn't over. In fact, it has just begun. We will need to run the largest and most effective campaign in history for the next five months to win the general election. The same billionaires whose money could not stop us before, are throwing everything they have to crush us. And the reality is that they are going to go after any candidate in any part of the country who dares to champion working people. What we will achieve together sends a message across America — and throughout the world. The people can topple political dynasties. The people can build coalitions. The people can win.
